Device Protection · coming soon

Protection plans, sold on the same bill.

Device Protection, coming soon to RetailerOS, will let your counter offer extended warranty and damage protection plans on the phones, ACs and TVs you sell — right on the bill. Each plan is tied to the unit's IMEI or serial number, and where the plan provider supports it, claims will be raised from RetailerOS.

How it works

  1. Bill the device

    Scan the IMEI or serial number as usual.

  2. Offer a plan

    The plans for that product show on screen.

  3. Add it to the bill

    The customer pays once; cover is linked to the unit.

  4. Claim when needed

    Raise the claim from the device's record.

On a real counter

A new flagship phone

Screen damage and extended warranty offered at the counter, when the customer is most likely to say yes.

An AC installation

Extended warranty on the compressor, added to the same bill as the installation.

A cracked screen

The customer walks in; one search on the IMEI shows the cover, and the claim starts from there.

Questions

When will Device Protection be available?

It is coming soon. Book a demo if you want to be among the first stores to use it.

Which protection providers will it work with?

RetailerOS is building integrations with device-protection providers. Where a provider offers an API, plans and claims will run from RetailerOS.

Will my store earn on each plan?

Plans are sold by your store, and the earnings on each one will be shown in RetailerOS.

Can I raise claims from RetailerOS?

Where the plan provider supports it, yes — claims will be raised from the device's record in RetailerOS.
